$comment: Chat events for regulars: a viewer shares a watch streak (Chat Notifications, notice_type watch_streak; message written by the streamer, $(twitch.streak) = streams in a row; Twitch streaks come as 3, 5, 7, 10, then every 5), a mod shares their anniversary (built-in default in both languages, chat_notification_defaults.ts), another streamer shouts the channel out (Shoutout Received; English default from chat_event_catalog.ts, Spanish written by the streamer). Twitch notices use Twitch's own wording. All free.

title.es: Día tranquilo en la granja, ven a pasar el rato
